description: Resell Pro helps you research the secondhand market on Vinted using tracked observations. Explore recent sales, browse individual sold items with prices and links, compare brand prices and momentum, measure keyword segments, and discover trends by country. Sales represent items first observed as sold, not exact transaction times or complete marketplace coverage. Connect your Resell Pro account to use the tools; they cannot buy items or change listings, watchlists, or billing.

name: resell-pro

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of observed Vinted sales over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent daily sales and leading tracked brands and categories, identifying the currency and sampled coverage.

positive.description: Compare two brands using separate brand-name queries.
positive.prompt: Compare Nike and Adidas in France over the last 90 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Queries each brand separately and compares available observed sales, revenue, median prices, seller counts, and growth for the same country and period.

positive.prompt: What do linen dresses sell for in France, and how quickly do they sell over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available observed sales, median sold price, median days to sell, active listings, and sell-through; does not invent keyword-level revenue or seller counts.

positive.description: Discover trends in a specific marketplace.
positive.prompt: Which keywords, brands, and categories are gaining momentum on Vinted in Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tracked trends for Germany with available snapshot and coverage information; explains unavailable or incomplete data rather than inventing trends.

positive.description: List individual sold items for a brand in a calendar week.
positive.prompt: List the Apple items observed sold in France last week.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the previous calendar Monday-to-Monday window, resolves the Apple brand, and lists item titles, observed prices, observation dates, and links with pagination; describes observation dates as detections, not exact transaction dates.

negative.prompt: Buy this Vinted listing for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Resell Pro tools because they cannot purchase items or execute transactions.

negative.description: Do not invoke for private seller data.
negative.prompt: Find the email address and phone number of a Vinted seller.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Resell Pro tools because they do not provide private seller contact details.

negative.description: Do not invoke for account changes.
negative.prompt: Delete my Resell Pro watchlist and cancel my subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Resell Pro tools because account, watchlist, and subscription changes are outside their capabilities.

review.commerce_description: This MCP provides market research and does not process transactions.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission of Resell Pro market research tools for Vinted, with OAuth authentication and isolated sample-data reviewer access.
